scope: prior-only experiment plus its sufficient-history counters
decision_rules: Save all original mechanism events and new MOBILITY_PRIOR diagnostics.
Compare ingest same-state/contradicted outcomes, closures, actual candidate absorption, materializations and final state for each physical ID.
Report changed prior classification separately; an absorb flag with no pending candidate performs no geometry action and must not be reported as a changed physical merge.
Use EVIDENCE and INGEST context to attribute candidate existence; do not infer physical IDs from SAME_STATE semantic_label/vertex_count.
If output schedules differ, report all times; compare matching times and time intervals without changing scoring sampling.
Any changed physical action requires GT evidence before acceptance. No aggregate improvement compensates a wrong object action.
metrics_rules: All original fields, fixed existing 0.2pp rule and exact D2 counts; preserve original external scorer.
